entries.name: ERROR_INVALID_NAME
entries.cause: bcdboot received a /s target that is not a bare drive letter, a missing or quoted Windows directory, or /f ALL while the firmware mode is unknown.
entries.detection: bcdboot exits 123. The log says the filename, directory name, or volume label syntax is incorrect.
repair_order: Confirm %SystemRoot% exists and pass it as its own list item, with no extra quotes.
Read the live drive map and take the ESP or system volume letter.
If the volume is only a folder mount or a \\?\Volume{GUID}\ path, assign a temporary letter with Add-PartitionAccessPath, then diskpart assign letter=, then mountvol.
Pass /s as S: with no trailing slash and no quotes.
Do not pass /f ALL when the firmware mode is unknown.
Treat exit 123 as failure. Re-read bcdedit /enum {bootmgr} and the ESP files before any GO.
entries.rollback: Remove only the temporary letter this attempt assigned. Leave the previous boot files in place.
